result.title: Outward-rounded certificate for the H2 record (k = 15,856): M_15856 > 8 re-certified in exact rational + arb ball arithmetic, and shown to need no Berry-Esseen input
result.status: complete; certificate PASSES (M_15856 >= 8.013326752751306578613695503115 with C_BE=0.56; >= 8.00677408008999410774 with no Berry-Esseen at all); tuple admissible, diameter 173,438; record theorem conditional only on recalled statements of Maynard's theorem and Bombieri-Vinogradov

claims.statement: The H2 <= 173,438 record certifies the pure Maynard-Tao criterion M_k > 2m/theta with m=2 and theta -> 1/2 (Bombieri-Vinogradov), i.e. M_15856 > 8, for a closed-simplex product test function F = prod g(k t_i) 1[sum t_i <= 1] (no epsilon-trick, no vanishing-marginal variant, no cap), plus an admissible 15,856-tuple of diameter 173,438.
claims.evidence: Reconstructed from p9_mk_engine.py, p9_certify_hp.py, scratchpad p9_exact_cert.py (sha256 496c3d80...4b76, uncommitted; copied to scripts/r1_h2_reference_p9_exact_cert_scratchpad_copy.py), p9_exact_cert_k15856.json, p9_scan.py mode pure2; see report Section 1.

claims.statement: For g >= 0 piecewise linear on [0,T], X_i iid with density g^2/c2, K=k-1: M_k >= E[G((k-S_K)_+)^2]/(c2 P(S_k<=k)) >= c2^{-1} sum_j max(0,1-beta_j)(G(b_j)^2-G(a_j)^2) for ANY upper bounds beta_j >= P(S_K >= k-b_j); the chord-majorised Chernoff bound, the one-big-jump bound C(K,2)q_B^2 + e^{-lam(s-T)} Mbar_B(lam)^K, and the Berry-Esseen bound with the elementary Phibar(z) <= min(exp(-z^2/2)/(z sqrt(2pi)), exp(-z^2/2)/2) are all valid.
claims.evidence: Lemmas 1-6 with complete proofs in report Section 2 (exact reduction of I and J^{(k)}, layer-cake identity via Tonelli, monotone per-piece bound, convexity chord bound, Markov/union bound, Berry-Esseen with two elementary Mills-type bounds proved by differentiation).

claims.statement: Rigorous re-certification with the stored g (400 exact-dyadic nodes) and C_BE = 0.56: the bound value lies in [8.013326752751306578613695503115, 8.013326752751306578613695503116]; the lower end is an exact rational (434-bit numerator) computed with every non-polynomial operation (exp, log, sqrt, pi) enclosed outward in python-flint/arb at 200 bits, and identically (30 digits) by an independent mpmath.iv implementation with directed-rounding conversions and a 2^-150 guard band. Margin over 8: 0.013326752751306578613695503115.
claims.evidence: scripts/r1_h2_interval_cert.py --backend both (7.4 s); data/h2_k15856_interval_cert.json (exact parameters: hex node data, lambda grid, B fractions, constants, per-node beta chain, exact rational cert_lo_exact); data/r1_h2_interval_cert_run.log.

claims.statement: With Berry-Esseen removed entirely (plain Chernoff + chord majorisation + Markov only): M_15856 >= 8.00677408008999410774 > 8, so the H2 record depends on no probabilistic literature constant, only on Maynard's theorem and Bombieri-Vinogradov (any theta > 0.49958 suffices). The certificate also passes with every historical BE constant (0.4748, 0.56, 0.7056, 0.7915, 0.7975). Bonus: the H3 profile gives M_923601 >= 12.006666706750045697 (matches the announced value) and >= 12.00263034990571191492 BE-free (M_k part only).
claims.evidence: variants table in data/h2_k15856_interval_cert.json and report Section 3.4; data/h3_k923601_interval_cert_Mk_only.json, data/h3_k923601_Mk_only_run.log (5.9 s).

claims.statement: The historical number 8.013326752751306 is reproduced exactly: float(exact lower bound) equals it bit-for-bit; per-node beta upper bounds agree with the historical JSON to 6.9e-18 at all 399 nodes with the identical strategy split (377 plain Chernoff, 22 BE); the committed mpmath+SAFE script's three regimes (8.01332675275 / 8.01593628081 / 8.01916114663) and the replayed arb script (8.0133267528) are also reproduced; the rigorous arb-erfc variant gives 8.01593628080580075677.
claims.evidence: scripts/r1_h2_crosscheck.py -> data/r1_h2_crosscheck.log; data/h2_k15856_replay_arb.log (1.9 s); data/h2_k15856_replay_mpmath_hp.log (30.5 s).

claims.statement: p9_tuple_k15856.npy (sha256 9a0ba71e981b75606fcd02b5ecc17b210416e6ad61ffe0e0267b7e86d9a75c0b) has 15,856 distinct sorted integers in [-86719, 86719], diameter 173,438, and is admissible: for each of the 1,847 primes p <= 15,856 (largest 15,823; count and largest confirmed by sympy.primepi/prevprime) the residues miss at least one class mod p; two independent implementations (pure-Python sets, numpy bincount) report zero violations.
claims.evidence: check_tuple() in scripts/r1_h2_interval_cert.py; 'tuple' block of data/h2_k15856_interval_cert.json; report Section 4.

claims.statement: The Astra audit item is correct: the committed p9_certify_hp.py is 50-digit round-to-nearest mpmath with a multiplicative slack SAFE = 1+1e-30 applied at eight places, which is not outward rounding and not a proof by itself; the JSON was produced by an arb script that existed only in the scratchpad. Repaired: the arb script is now in the repo with its sha256, and D1.3/D1.4 are independent of it.

Not established tonight: the precise statements of Maynard's Prop. 4.1 / Polymath 8b Thm 3.5(i) and of Bombieri-Vinogradov were recalled, not re-read at source; Berry-Esseen constants are recalled (irrelevant to D1.4); the FLINT/arb library and hardware are trusted (mpmath.iv is a second implementation but its transcendental directed rounding is best-effort, hence the guard band); the k = 923,601 tuple was not re-verified.

Pitfall found: mpmath.iv.mpf(2**300+12345) returns the degenerate interval [2^300, 2^300], which does not contain its argument (no outward rounding on big-integer conversion); a naive mpmath.iv port of the certifier would be unsound. Handled with libmp.from_rational floor/ceiling conversions plus enclosure asserts.
claims.evidence: MpmathBackend in scripts/r1_h2_interval_cert.py (self-tests); report Section 7 item 1.

unresolved: Statement-level verification of Maynard's theorem (Prop. 4.1, Ann. of Math. 181 (2015)) and Polymath 8b Thm 3.5(i) against the primary texts; both are recalled, not fetched (WebFetch not attempted; coordination file says the relevant sites are egress-blocked). The record theorem is conditional on these two recalled statements plus Bombieri-Vinogradov.

Library trust: the certificate rests on python-flint 0.9.0 / FLINT-arb ball arithmetic at 200 bits; a third route (exact rational Taylor enclosures of the ~28k exponentials, or a proof-assistant check of the 399-term sum) would remove this dependence.

The k = 923,601 (H3) tuple admissibility was not re-verified tonight (about 7e10 residue operations; needs a compiled sieve); only the M_923601 >= 12.0067 (and BE-free >= 12.0026) part was re-certified.
Whether the 0.0068-0.0133 margin could be spent to certify a smaller k for m = 2 (outside D1).

Claim rows appended to overnight/fable/CLAIMS.md. No git commit/push; git status confirms no changes outside overnight/fable/ (other modified/untracked files there belong to concurrent agents). Key findings for the coordinator: (1) the record number is reproduced bit-for-bit by an independent exact-rational + outward-rounded implementation; (2) the record does NOT need Berry-Esseen: Markov + convexity alone give 8.0068 > 8 (and 12.0026 > 12 for H3), so the hypothesis chain is just Maynard + Bombieri-Vinogradov; (3) the cost of the certificate is independent of k (7 s), so the 'smallest feasible k' fallback was unnecessary; (4) the committed mpmath+SAFE script is indeed not outward-rounded (Astra was right), the real arb certifier was uncommitted and is now preserved with its hash.
